findings.title: Water now / Save watering requests never time out; button stays on 'Watering…' and disabled forever
findings.steps: On /beds make POST /api/waterings hang (route that never responds), click 'Water now' on North bed, wait 40+ seconds.
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s with a visible error; button re-enabled.
findings.actual: Button still reads 'Watering…' and is disabled after ~45 s; no error. useApiClient/useApiFetch set no timeout, so list loads on /waterings would likewise show 'Loading waterings…' indefinitely.
findings.evidence: Button state after wait: ['Watering…\nNorth bed', disabled=true].

findings.title: Retrying Water now after a lost response creates a duplicate watering
findings.steps: Make the POST reach the server but drop the response (network error). Page shows 'The garden server could not be reached.' Click 'Water now' again.
findings.expected: One watering recorded (idempotency key or dedupe).
findings.actual: Two waterings recorded for Shade corner one second apart (ids 4 and 5, 17:09:29 and 17:09:30).
findings.evidence: GET /api/waterings listed two Shade corner entries with watered_at 17:09:29 and 17:09:30 after one failed and one successful click.

findings.title: Watering list and dashboard error states have no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings return 500, open the dashboard and click 'All waterings'.
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that reloads the list once the server is back.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load waterings.' with no button in main (the only way to recover is changing the filter or reloading). The dashboard section also shows only an alert; its refresh is not even destructured.
findings.evidence: main buttons list was empty in the error state; index.vue destructures only data and error for wateringsResult.

findings.title: Past-watering form is crushed at 375 px: Date and Litres inputs are ~28 px wide
findings.steps: Set the viewport to 375 px, open /beds and click 'Record past watering' for a bed.
findings.expected: Fields are usable (stacked on narrow screens).
findings.actual: The .water-form grid is '1fr 1fr auto', so the buttons take most of the width and the date and number inputs shrink to tiny boxes where no value is visible.
findings.evidence: Screenshot scratch/beds375.png: Date and Litres inputs are about 28 px wide next to 'Save watering' and 'Cancel'.

findings.title: Oversized bed_id / watering id gives 500 instead of 4xx
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error on all three (SQLite integer overflow). Reachable from the UI with /waterings?bed=99999999999999999999.

findings.title: Beds load failure on the waterings page goes unnoticed: filter silently has only 'All beds'
findings.steps: Make GET /api/beds return 500 and navigate to /waterings from the dashboard link.
findings.expected: Error saying the beds could not be loaded, with a retry.
findings.actual: The select shows only 'All beds', with no message; the beds error is ignored.
findings.evidence: select options length = 1; no alert shown.

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted but shown as '0 L'
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.001 (or POST litres 1e-300).
findings.expected: Either reject amounts below a sensible minimum (input has min=0.1) or show the real value.
findings.actual: Saved, and the notice says 'Recorded 0 L on 12 Nov 2026.'; lists show 0 L. Client checks only >0 and the server only gt=0.

findings.title: Implausible dates such as year 0001 are accepted
findings.expected: Refused with a visible reason (no lower bound on the date).

findings.title: Invalid or unknown ?bed= in the URL shows a raw validation message or an unselected filter
findings.expected: A friendly message, or the filter falls back to all beds.
findings.actual: bed=abc shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'. bed=999 shows a blank select (selectedIndex -1) and 'No waterings for this bed'.

findings.title: Watering two beds at once re-enables the first bed's button while its request is pending
findings.steps: Click 'Water now' on bed A while its request is slow, then click 'Water now' on bed B.
findings.expected: Bed A's button stays disabled until its request finishes.
findings.actual: wateringBedId is a single ref, so it moves to B and A can be clicked again, which records a duplicate. A's error or notice can also be lost, because waterError and waterNotice are single values that are cleared.
findings.evidence: Code: beds.vue recordWatering sets wateringBedId.value = bed.id and clears it in finally.
